chapters.title: Prim with a distance array (dense graphs)
chapters.code:
def min_cost_connect_points(points):
    n = len(points)
    dist = [float("inf")] * n
    dist[0] = 0
    in_tree = [False] * n
    total = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        i = min((d, j) for j, d in enumerate(dist) if not in_tree[j])[1]
        in_tree[i] = True
        total += dist[i]
        xi, yi = points[i]
        for j in range(n):
            if not in_tree[j]:
                d = abs(xi - points[j][0]) + abs(yi - points[j][1])
                if d < dist[j]:
                    dist[j] = d
    return total
